verdict.line: You lose the poke phase from levels 1-5 before Hallowed Mist lets you close his range advantage, but you win from level 9 on once Shadowflame and Rabadon's outscale his Remove Scurvy sustain.

brief.thesis: Gangplank's Parrrley hits for 625 range on a 5-second cooldown, which outranges Snip Snip! (450) and Skip 'n Slash (400) entirely, so he can chip you for free before you're ever in position to fight back. Remove Scurvy then clears any slow from Needlework and heals off the chip damage, undoing your poke in one button. Your only counter to the range gap is Hallowed Mist, which makes you untargetable to anyone standing outside it.

theirWindow.when: Parrrley poking you outside melee range
theirWindow.what: Walk up under W (Hallowed Mist) so he can't target you from outside it - this is the only way to erase his 625-range Parrrley edge over your 450-range Q and close to a fight on your terms.

yourWindow.what: All-in immediately: E (Skip 'n Slash) dash in, Q (Snip Snip!) for the true-damage center snips, then R (Needlework) to slow. Without Remove Scurvy up (22/21/20/19/18s) he can't cleanse the slow or heal the trade back.

powerCurve.note: Parrrley poke wins every early trade
R slow answers, Remove Scurvy answers back
Full combo threatens him, teamfights vary

start.item: Doran's Ring > Health Potion > Health Potion
start.why: The highest-picked start (74.5% of games, 51.4% WR over 1110) gives mana sustain to hold W (Hallowed Mist) up through his poke phase and the two potions offset Grog-Soaked Blade poison chip.

boots.why: 56.3% win rate over 462 games, ahead of Plated Steelcaps - the extra magic pen accelerates the burst window where you punish him once Remove Scurvy is down.

core.why: First item in the strongest measured path (57.3% WR, 288 games) - sets up the burst spike that defines your 9-13 power window.
Adds the execute-style burst that lets Snip Snip! and Needlework punish him before he can land a second Parrrley.
Caps the burst spike that has to one-shot him since you can't out-sustain his poison poke through pure stats alone.

situational.when: he's out-trading you and you need sustain through the poison and Parrrley chip instead of a hard burst spike
he's grouped a kill threat on you post-6 and you need to survive the Cannon Barrage window to land your own R
you're ahead and want faster E (Skip 'n Slash) attack speed uptime to snowball resets on him

runes.keystoneWhy: Conqueror's sustained-fight scaling rewards landing autos and abilities through extended trades, which is exactly the fight you're forcing once you close range under Hallowed Mist.

summoners.why: Flash+Ignite is both the highest win rate (53.6%) and most-picked (62.7%) combo - Ignite adds guaranteed burst to close out all-ins and offsets the free healing he gets off Remove Scurvy.

playing.title: Approach only under Hallowed Mist
playing.detail: W makes you untargetable to anyone outside it, so use it to walk through his Parrrley range instead of eating free poke while closing distance on foot.

playing.title: Track Remove Scurvy before committing R
playing.detail: Needlework's slow gets erased the instant he presses W (22/21/20/19/18s cooldown). Only commit your full combo when you've seen him use it or it's clearly down.

playing.title: Don't contest levels 1-3 trades
playing.detail: His Parrrley poke plus follow-up out-damages your melee kit before E and R are online - this is his measured solo-kill window, so play for CS, not trades.

playing.title: Dash in with E before swinging
playing.detail: Skip 'n Slash's attack speed, range, and magic on-hit window turns close-range trades in your favor, and landing a hit during it partially refunds the cooldown for a second engage.

playing.title: Use Q's true damage to punish stand-and-fight
playing.detail: The center snips of Snip Snip! deal true damage and apply A Thousand Cuts, which is the one source of damage his Remove Scurvy heal can't fully undo.

playing.title: Hold all-ins for post-9 item spikes
playing.detail: Once Dusk and Dawn into Shadowflame comes online you have the burst to kill through his sustain - before that, trade passively and let the lane stay even.

brief.patchCaveat: Build, runes, summoners, and all win rates above come from measured Gwen vs Gangplank games on the current patch (16.19.1) via OP.GG; the mechanical reasoning and trade-window advice are my own tactical read, not measured data.
